searchText: 😫 Gas FEES RISES AGAIN TO 250 GWEI. Uniswap V2 again on fire. Does anyone have any Rinkeby ETH I can have? Or Ropsten? <@!301186049323958275> I have some ropsten Ether, how much do you want and what address? <@!144468805697929216> 0x3DE7D7c3D9CCa18C1dA05b26a5FCCD101DBaB68F if you wouldn't mind. Don't need much, just demoing some DeFi tools to some people and need not-0. 🙂 1-5 would be nice if you have a billion, if you only have a little then less is fine. (enough to cover gas without worrying too much) <@!301186049323958275> sent Thanks! Is someone "attacking" Ropsten? The only transactions that are getting mined are 300 nanoeth+ ones, and every block is mined by the same miner, and every block with without a 500 nanoeth+ transaction is empty. (I don't normally use Ropsten, so this may be normal, but it wasn't like this a couple hours ago when I used it). <@!301186049323958275> https://twitter.com/hudsonjameson/status/1299848015243554816 💯 💯 👍
